entries.jp: 坂本龍馬殿\n高杉晋作殿\n桂小五郎殿
entries.en: Sakamoto-dono,\nTakasugi-dono,\nKatsura-dono...

entries.jp: 我が御前試合に\nようこそ
entries.en: Welcome to my\nRoyal Concert.

entries.jp: うん？\nあんたがわしらを招待\nしてくれたお人か？
entries.en: Hm? You the fella\nwho invited us?

entries.jp: そうです\n私は井伊直弼
entries.en: Indeed. I am\nNaosuke Ii.

entries.jp: 徳川慶喜様の命により\nこの御前試合を仕切って\nおります
entries.en:
By order of
Yoshinobu-sama,
I am overseeing
this Royal
Concert.

entries.jp: う……\n徳川家大老\n井伊直弼か
entries.en:
Ugh... The
Tokugawa's Great
Elder, Naosuke
Ii...

entries.jp: はい
entries.en: Yes.

entries.jp: こいつはなんじゃ？\n底知れない力を\nビシビシ感じる……
entries.en:
What is this guy?
I can feel this
bottomless power
cracklin' off him...

entries.jp: 背筋が寒くなって\n尻がビリビリしてきた
entries.en:
Chills are runnin'
down my spine,
and my backside's
all tingly.

entries.jp: テラーダで感じたのと\n同じ感じ……
entries.en: It's the same\nfeelin' I got back\nat Terada...

entries.jp: なにか？
entries.en: Is something the\nmatter?

entries.jp: あ　いやあ\nなんでもない
entries.en: Ah, nah... it's\nnothin'.

entries.jp: 怖じ気付いたのなら\nここで引き返す道も\nありましょう
entries.en:
If you have lost
your nerve, you
may still turn
back here.

entries.jp: あなた方が尻尾を巻いて\n逃げたところで\n恥ではありませんよ？
entries.en:
There would be
no shame in
tucking tail and
running, you
know?

entries.jp: なんだと！\nここまで来て\n逃げるわけがねぇだろ！
entries.en:
What!? We came
all this way!
There's no way
we're running!

entries.jp: そうじゃ\nそうじゃ！
entries.en: That's right!\nThat's right!

entries.jp: 二人とも　落ち着いて\n声を荒げたら失礼ですよ
entries.en:
Calm down, both
of you. Raising
your voices is
rude.

entries.jp: 御大老様\nご招待ありがとう\nございました
entries.en:
Your Excellency
the Great Elder,
thank you very
much for inviting
us.

entries.jp: お心遣い痛み入りますが\n心配には及びませんので\n精一杯演じさせて頂きます
entries.en:
We're grateful for
your concern, but
there's no need to
worry. We shall
perform to the
very best of our
ability.

entries.jp: はははは\nそれは頼もしい
entries.en: Ha ha ha ha. How\nreassuring.

entries.jp: そうそう　坂本殿
entries.en: Oh yes,\nSakamoto-dono.

entries.jp: な　なんじゃ？
entries.en: Wh-what?

entries.jp: 慶喜様もあなた方を\nたいそう気にして\nおいでだ
entries.en:
Yoshinobu-sama
has taken quite
an interest in you
all.

entries.jp: 今日の御前試合は\n精一杯力を尽くすように
entries.en:
Do give
everything you
have at today's
Royal Concert.

entries.jp: 楽しみにしていますよ
entries.en: I am looking\nforward to it.

entries.jp: なあ　シンディ\nセンセー\nあいつは何者じゃ？
entries.en: Hey, Shindy,\nSensei. Who is\nthat guy?

entries.jp: ただならぬ気配を\nまとってて気味が悪い
entries.en:
He's got this
unnatural air
about him. Gives
me the creeps.

entries.jp: 井伊直弼といやあ\n徳川慶喜直下の\n切れ者って噂だ
entries.en:
Naosuke Ii, huh?
Rumor says he's a
sharp one,
serving right
under Yoshinobu
Tokugawa.

entries.jp: あの若さで大老だぜ\nただ者じゃねえのは\n間違いねえ
entries.en:
Great Elder at his
age? No doubt
about it, he's no
ordinary guy.

entries.jp: わしが言いたいのは\nそんな事じゃない
entries.en: That ain't what\nI'm gettin' at.

entries.jp: ドロドロとした\nこう　なんちゅうか\n黒い力を感じたんじゃ！
entries.en: I felt this sludgy...\nhow do I put it...\nthis black power!

entries.jp: 背筋は寒くなるし\n胸が疼くんじゃ……
entries.en:
Chills down my
spine, and my
chest aches
somethin' awful...

entries.jp: なんだ龍馬\n今さら\n怖じ気付いたのか？
entries.en: What's this,\nRyoma? Losing\nyour nerve now?

entries.jp: だからこれは罠だって\n最初に言ったじゃない\nですか
entries.en:
Didn't I say from
the very start
that this was a
trap?

entries.jp: 違うんじゃ\nシンディ　センセー\n怖じ気付いてはおらん
entries.en:
That ain't it,
Shindy, Sensei. I
ain't lost my
nerve.

entries.jp: あいつは人と違う\n得体の知れん力が\n秘められているんじゃ！
entries.en:
That guy ain't like
other people. He's
got some kinda
strange power
hidden inside
him!

entries.jp: ほらみろ　やっぱり\n怖じ気付いてんじゃねえか
entries.en: See? Told ya, you\nARE losing your\nnerve.

entries.jp: 井伊にはなんらかの\n思惑があっての\n招待ですからね
entries.en:
Ii invited us with
some kind of
scheme in mind,
after all.

entries.jp: なんであれ\n警戒しておくに\nこしたことはないですよ
entries.en: Whatever it is, it\nnever hurts to\nstay on guard.

entries.jp: ううう\nわかってもらえんな
entries.en: Ugh... Nobody\ngets it.

entries.jp: なんじゃろうな\nこの気色悪さは
entries.en: What is this\ncreepy feelin'...

entries.jp: 気合いをいれんと\n呑まれてしまうぜよ
entries.en:
If I don't fire
myself up, it's
gonna swallow me
whole!

entries.jp: よし　オレ様が\n気合いを入れてやる
entries.en: All right, yours\ntruly will fire you\nup.

entries.jp: うりゃっ！
entries.en: Hyah!

entries.jp: ふぎゃっ！\nし……心臓が
entries.en: Fgyah! M-my\nheart...

entries.jp: 気合い入れだ\n胸のモゾモゾは\n治ったか？
entries.en:
That's how you
fire someone up.
That fidgety
thing in your
chest fixed?

entries.jp: おっ？\n言われて見れば\nなおったぜよ
entries.en: Oh? Now that ya\nmention it, it's\ngone!

entries.jp: おっしゃああ！\nガンガンシャウトして\n嫌な気分を振り切るぜよ
entries.en:
Hell yeah! I'll
shout my lungs
out and shake off
this rotten feelin'!

entries.jp: センセー\nわしらの出番はいつじゃ
entries.en: Sensei, when's\nour turn?

entries.jp: 天気が悪くなりそうで\nはよ終わらせたいぜよ
entries.en:
Weather looks
like it's turnin'
bad. I wanna
wrap this up
quick.

entries.jp: 私達は後になりますね\n招待されると客扱いに\nなりますから
entries.en:
We'll go on later.
Being invited
means we're
treated as guests.

entries.jp: そうか　後組か\nシンディもセンセーも\nよろしく頼むぜよ！
entries.en:
The later group,
huh? Shindy,
Sensei, I'm
countin' on ya!

entries.jp: 偉そうに言うんじゃねえ\nお前こそオレ様のロックに\nついてこれるのか？
entries.en:
Don't act so high
and mighty. Can
YOU even keep
up with the great
Takasugi's rock?

entries.jp: そ　その前に\nわしは　ちいと\n厠へ行ってくる
entries.en: B-before that, I'm\ngonna, uh... pop\nover to the privy.

entries.jp: 悪寒はそのせいか\nさっさと行ってこい！
entries.en:
So THAT's what
your chills are
about! Hurry up
and go!

entries.jp: それとは\nまったく違うぜよ
entries.en: That's a whole\ndifferent thing.

entries.jp: もう　いいから\n今すぐ黙って厠へ行くか\n死ぬまでガマンしてろ！
entries.en:
Enough already!
Either shut up
and go to the
privy right now,
or hold it till you
die!

entries.jp: おう　二人とも\nここで待っててくれ\nすぐ戻ってくる
entries.en: Right, you two\nwait here. I'll be\nright back.

entries.jp: 龍馬くん\nちょっと\n無理してますね
entries.en: Ryoma-kun is\npushing himself a\nbit, isn't he?

entries.jp: あれで誤魔化している\nつもりなんだろうよ
entries.en:
He probably
thinks he's
fooling us with
that act.

entries.jp: 私はね\n龍馬くんの直感を\n信じているんですよ
entries.en: You know, I trust\nRyoma-kun's\nintuition.

entries.jp: この御前試合は最初から\n我々を陥れる罠ですから
entries.en:
This Royal
Concert was a
trap to ensnare
us from the very
start.

entries.jp: 井伊は何かを仕組んで\nいるはず……\nそう思うでしょ　晋作
entries.en:
Ii must be
plotting
something... Don't
you think so,
Shinsaku?

entries.jp: 当然そうだろうな
entries.en: Obviously.

entries.jp: 晋作も\n感じているでしょう？\nこの感じ……
entries.en:
You feel it too,
don't you,
Shinsaku? This
feeling...

entries.jp: だな　どこか禍々しい……\nオレ様の片魂がどこか\nざわついてる様な感じだぜ
entries.en:
Yeah. Something
sinister... It's like
the great
Takasugi's Piece
Soul is stirring.

entries.jp: 私もです　龍馬くんの\n様子を見ても偶然とは思わ\nないほうがよさそうですね
entries.en:
Me too. Judging
by Ryoma-kun's
state, we'd better
not assume this is
a coincidence.

entries.jp: オレ様達の雷舞が終わる\nまでは気を抜かないよう\n警戒しておこう
entries.en:
Let's stay on
guard and not let
up until our live
is over.

entries.jp: 一番気を付けなければ\nならないのは　恐らく\n新選組の雷舞でしょうね
entries.en:
What we most
need to watch out
for is probably
the Shinsengumi's
live.

entries.jp: 龍馬くんの歌を人々に\n聴かせる前に　なにかを\n仕掛けてくるはずです
entries.en:
They're bound to
try something
before
Ryoma-kun's song
can reach the
people.

entries.jp: お待たせしたな！\nわしが戻ったから\nもう大丈夫！
entries.en:
Sorry to keep ya
waitin'! I'm back,
so everything's
fine now!

entries.jp: はあ……\n最高に大丈夫じゃねえ\nやつが戻って来やがった
entries.en:
Sigh... The guy
who's the furthest
thing from fine
just came back.

entries.jp: うん？\nなんの話をしてた？
entries.en: Hm? What were\nyou two talkin'\nabout?

entries.jp: 気を引き締めようって\nそういう話ですよ\nね　晋作
entries.en: About keeping\nour guard up.\nRight, Shinsaku?

entries.jp: そうだな\nそろそろあちらさんの\n雷舞が始まるみたいだぜ
entries.en: Yeah. Looks like\ntheir live's about\nto start.

entries.jp: まずは敵の出方を\n見ようじゃねぇか
entries.en: Let's see what the\nenemy's got first.

entries.jp: おお！\nそりゃ大変じゃ\n早く行かんと
entries.en: Whoa! That's bad!\nWe gotta hurry!

entries.jp:
三人は頷きあうと
会場へ向かった
空には暗雲が立ちこめ
徐々に青空が消えていった
entries.en:
The three nodded
to each other and
headed for the
venue. Dark
clouds gathered
in the sky, and
the blue slowly
faded away.

entries.jp: 御前試合の会場には\n徐々に観客が\nやってきていた
entries.en:
Spectators were
gradually
arriving at the
Royal Concert
venue.

entries.jp:
観客達は
老若男女を問わず
入り交じり雷舞を楽しみに
している様子であった
entries.en:
Young and old,
men and women
alike, they
mingled together,
seemingly looking
forward to the
live.

entries.jp: しかし\n何か様子がおかしい
entries.en: And yet,\nsomething was\noff.

entries.jp: ううう\nみな生気を抜かれた\nような目をしているぜよ
entries.en:
Ugh... Everybody's
got eyes like the
life's been sucked
right outta them.

entries.jp: 天歌に浸り切っていれば\n誰だってやがては\nああなってしまいます
entries.en:
Anyone who
steeps themselves
in Heaven's Song
will end up like
that sooner or
later.

entries.jp: 気味が悪いな
entries.en: Creepy.

entries.jp: よっしゃ！\nわしの歌で元気を\n取り戻させるぜよ！
entries.en: All right! I'll bring\n'em back to life\nwith my song!

entries.jp: いくら龍馬くんでも\nそう簡単にはいかないと\n思うんですけど
entries.en:
Even for you,
Ryoma-kun, I
don't think it'll be
that easy...

entries.jp: 桂さんは龍馬を\n信じてるのか心配するのか\nどっちなんだよ
entries.en:
Katsura-san, do
you believe in
Ryoma or are you
worried about
him? Which is it?

entries.jp: 信じているのと\n心配するのは\n別物でしょ
entries.en:
Believing in
someone and
worrying about
them are two
different things.

entries.jp: よくわからねえが……\nおい　そろそろ\n先行の雷舞が始まるぜ
entries.en:
I don't really get
it... Hey, the
opening live's
about to start.

entries.jp: ありゃあ新選組の\nソウちんたちじゃな
entries.en:
That's the
Shinsengumi...
So-chin and his
crew!

entries.jp: 新選組は幕府の\n最高愛獲ですからね
entries.en:
The Shinsengumi
are the
shogunate's top
idols, after all.

entries.jp: 生気が抜けたような\n観客達は彼らの姿を\n見るなり歓声をあげた
entries.en:
The moment they
saw them, the
lifeless-looking
spectators let out
a cheer.

entries.jp: なんじゃっ\n観客の周りが変じゃ！
entries.en: What the!?\nSomethin's weird\naround the crowd!

entries.jp: 急に生気を\n取り戻した？
entries.en: Did they suddenly\ncome back to life?

entries.jp: 違う！
entries.en: No!

entries.jp: もやみたいなのが見える\n観客の歓声と混じり\nあってるぜよ！
entries.en:
I can see
somethin' like a
haze! It's mixin'
with the crowd's
cheers!

entries.jp: 龍馬は\n舞台袖に座っている\n井伊直弼を見た
entries.en:
Ryoma looked at
Naosuke Ii,
seated in the
wings of the
stage.

entries.jp:
直弼は口元に
扇子を宛がい
何か呟いている
ように見える
entries.en:
Naosuke held a
folding fan to his
lips and seemed
to be murmuring
something.

entries.jp: オン\nキリキリバサラ\nウンハッタ……
entries.en: On kiri kiri basara\nun hatta...

entries.jp: うう……\nうあああ……\nうがああああ
entries.en: Ngh... Ugh...\nGRAAAAAH!

entries.jp: 舞台の中央に立つ\n沖田が急に苦しみだし\n獣のように叫ぶ
entries.en:
Standing at the
center of the
stage, Okita
suddenly began
to writhe in
agony, howling
like a beast.

entries.jp: なんじゃ　なんじゃ！\nソウちんの様子が\nおかしくなったぞ！
entries.en:
What the--what
the!? Somethin's
wrong with
So-chin!

entries.jp: なんでしょう……\nいきなり盛り上がったと\n思ったら……
entries.en:
What is this... Just
when the crowd
suddenly got
excited...

entries.jp: 急に会場の空気が\n澱んだような……
entries.en: ...the air in the\nvenue suddenly\nturned stagnant...

entries.jp: 真っ黒じゃ！\n井伊の気配みたいに\n真っ黒な気じゃ！
entries.en:
It's pitch black!
Pitch-black
energy, just like
Ii's aura!

entries.jp: 会場中に黒い気が\nとぐろを巻いているっ！\nソウちんに集まって行くぜよ
entries.en:
Black energy's
coilin' all through
the venue! It's
gatherin' around
So-chin!

entries.jp: こんままじゃソウちんが\n危ないっ！
entries.en: At this rate,\nSo-chin's in\ndanger!

entries.jp: 沖田を救おうと\n龍馬は舞台へと\n飛び出していった
entries.en: To save Okita,\nRyoma leapt out\nonto the stage.

entries.jp: あのバカ！\n一人でなに\nしようってんだ
entries.en: That idiot! What\ndoes he think he's\ndoing alone!?

entries.jp: 私も行きます！
entries.en: I'm going too!

entries.jp:
龍馬に続いて
高杉と桂も
舞台へと
飛びだしてゆく
entries.en:
Following Ryoma,
Takasugi and
Katsura dashed
out onto the stage
as well.

entries.jp: ソウちん　大丈夫か　\nしっかりしろ　ソウちん！
entries.en:
So-chin, you all
right!? Pull
yourself together,
So-chin!

entries.jp:
舞台中央で叫び崩れ
落ちた沖田がゆっくり
立ちあがる　そして
龍馬を見て微笑んだ
それは邪悪な笑みだった
entries.en:
Okita, who had
fallen screaming
at center stage,
slowly rose. Then
he looked at
Ryoma and
smiled. It was an
evil smile.

entries.jp: トサカくん……\n来てくれたんだね\n僕の歌を聴きに……ふふ
entries.en:
Tosaka-kun... You
came, didn't you?
To hear my song...
Hehe.

entries.jp: ソウちん……？
entries.en: So-chin...?

entries.jp: ふふふ\nねぇトサカくん\n僕の仲間になってよ
entries.en: Hehehe... Hey,\nTosaka-kun... be\nmy comrade.

entries.jp: 近藤さんはトサカくんが\n好きなんだよ？\n喜ぶから仲間になろうよ
entries.en:
Kondo-san likes
you, Tosaka-kun,
you know? It'd
make him happy,
so be our
comrade.

entries.jp: わし……わしにはもう\n仲間はいるんじゃ\n彦根でもそう言ったろう
entries.en:
I... I've already
got comrades. I
told ya so back in
Hikone, didn't I?

entries.jp: もう遅い……よ\nトサカくんは僕のもの\nいつも……一緒だよ
entries.en:
It's too late...
Tosaka-kun is
mine. We'll
always... be
together.

entries.jp: 狂気に縁取られた笑顔で\n沖田は歌い出した
entries.en:
With a smile
edged in
madness, Okita
began to sing.

entries.jp:
その歌に
舞台に広がっていた
黒い気が蠢く
まるで操るように
黒い気を沖田が
引きつけていく
entries.en:
At his song, the
black energy
spread across the
stage writhed. As
if controlling it,
Okita drew the
black energy to
himself.

entries.jp: 沖田の歌声が\nどす黒い気をまとって\n龍馬に襲い掛かった
entries.en:
Wrapped in a foul
black energy,
Okita's singing
voice lunged at
Ryoma.

entries.jp: \fnt1うおおおおおっ\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Uwoooooooh!\fnt0

entries.jp: 龍馬くんっ！
entries.en: Ryoma-kun!

entries.jp: 龍馬！
entries.en: Ryoma!

entries.jp: 龍馬を助けようと\n近づいた高杉と桂を\n龍馬は拒絶する
entries.en:
Takasugi and
Katsura moved in
to help Ryoma,
but Ryoma waved
them off.

entries.jp: ダメじゃ！　近寄るなっ\nソウちんの力はっ……\nぐううっ
entries.en: No! Stay back!\nSo-chin's power\nis... Grrgh!

entries.jp: あん時と段違いに強い\n負の波動じゃ……
entries.en:
It's a negative
wave way
stronger than last
time...

entries.jp: これを浴びたら\nひとたまりもないぜよ！
entries.en: Get hit by this\nand you won't\nstand a chance!

entries.jp:
沖田の歌と
黒い気に囚われ
龍馬は身動きも
できなくなる
entries.en:
Caught in Okita's
song and the
black energy,
Ryoma could no
longer move a
muscle.

entries.jp: 黒い気の影響で\n会場にいた観客達が\n次々と倒れていた
entries.en:
Under the black
energy's
influence, the
spectators in the
venue were
collapsing one
after another.

entries.jp: やべえな\n観客も影響受けて\n失神してやがる
entries.en:
This is bad. The
crowd's getting
hit too. They're
passing out.

entries.jp: こりゃやべぇぞ！\nハンパねえ力で\n圧して来やがるっ！
entries.en:
This is seriously
bad! It's crushing
down on us with
insane power!

entries.jp: まさかこんなに強い\n負の力を放つとはっ
entries.en:
I never imagined
he could unleash
such powerful
negative energy!

entries.jp: ぐうっ……\n押し潰されそうですっ！
entries.en: Ngh... I feel like\nI'm being crushed!

entries.jp: うう……
entries.en: Ugh...

entries.jp: 立っていられないっ\n晋作っ　龍馬くんっ\nうあああっ！
entries.en:
I can't stay
standing!
Shinsaku!
Ryoma-kun!
Aaaah!

entries.jp: くそっ　このオレ様を\n地面に伏せさせるとはっ
entries.en:
Dammit! Forcing
the great
Takasugi to the
ground!?

entries.jp:
倒れ伏す桂と高杉
そして　観客達も次々と
倒れていく　だが
身動きも取れない龍馬は
いまだ舞台に立っていた
entries.en:
Katsura and
Takasugi fell, and
the crowd
dropped one by
one. But Ryoma,
unable to move,
still stood on the
stage.

entries.jp: ふふふ\nまだ立っていられるんだ
entries.en: Hehehe... You can\nstill stand.

entries.jp: すごいねトサカくん\nさすがだよ
entries.en: Amazing,\nTosaka-kun. Just\nwhat I'd expect.

entries.jp: やめじゃ　ソウちん！\nお客さんが倒れとるぞ\nそれはやめるぜよ！
entries.en:
Stop it, So-chin!
The audience is
droppin'! Knock it
off!

entries.jp: ソウちんにも良くない\n感じがするんじゃ\nその歌はやめるぜよ！
entries.en:
I got a bad feelin'
it ain't good for
you either,
So-chin! Stop that
song!

entries.jp: 僕はやめないよ……\nトサカくんが倒れるまで
entries.en: I won't stop... not\nuntil you fall,\nTosaka-kun.

entries.jp: いや……違うかな\n歌いたくてたまらない\nだから歌うんだ
entries.en:
No... that's not
quite it. I want to
sing so badly I
can't stand it.
That's why I sing.

entries.jp: ぐ……\nやめるんじゃ\nソウちん
entries.en: Ngh... Stop it...\nSo-chin...

entries.jp: でも……これは\n僕が歌ってるのかな？
entries.en: But... is it really\nme who's singing?

entries.jp: 土方さん……\n近藤さんはどこ……？
entries.en: Hijikata-san...\nWhere's\nKondo-san...?

entries.jp: 沖田は\n頭を振って周りを見る　\nしかし――
entries.en: Okita shook his\nhead and looked\naround. But--

entries.jp: 続けろ　沖田
entries.en: Keep going,\nOkita.

entries.jp: 舞台袖に直弼の姿が見えた\n直弼は両手で印を結んで\n何かを呟いている
entries.en:
Naosuke could be
seen in the wings
of the stage. He
had both hands
joined in a mudra
and was
murmuring
something.

entries.jp: 井伊大老も\nああ言ってるし……\n僕は歌うよ
entries.en: Great Elder Ii\nsays so too... so I'll\nsing.

entries.jp: くうっ　井伊！\nソウちんになにをした！
entries.en: Grr... Ii! What'd\nyou do to\nSo-chin!?

entries.jp: もうやめろ　井伊！
entries.en: Cut it out, Ii!

entries.jp: なにか？\n我がなにをしたと？
entries.en:
Is something the
matter? What is it
you think I've
done?

entries.jp: 貴様……\nわしは誤魔化されん
entries.en: You... You ain't\nfoolin' me.

entries.jp: なにか怪しい術を使って\nソウちんを……
entries.en:
You used some
kinda shady
sorcery on
So-chin...

entries.jp: いますぐ術を解くんじゃ\n井伊！
entries.en: Undo that spell\nright now, Ii!

entries.jp: 何を言っているのだ？\n言い掛かりも程々にしろ
entries.en:
What are you
talking about?
Don't push your
baseless
accusations too
far.

entries.jp: とぼけるな井伊！\nわしは見たぞ！
entries.en: Don't play dumb,\nIi! I saw it!

entries.jp: 黒い気は井伊の\n気配と同じじゃ！
entries.en: That black energy\nfeels just like\nyour aura, Ii!

entries.jp: ソウちん！\n目を覚ませ！
entries.en: So-chin! Wake up!

entries.jp: 目を覚ます？\nそれは僕のほうじゃない
entries.en: Wake up? I'm not\nthe one who\nneeds to.

entries.jp: トサカくんが目を覚ます\n……その時が来たんだよ
entries.en:
It's you who
needs to wake up,
Tosaka-kun... The
time has come.

entries.jp: 僕が目を覚まさせてあげる
entries.en: I'll wake you up\nmyself.

entries.jp: 沖田から暗澹とした\n負の波動が龍馬に\n降り注ぐ
entries.en:
A gloomy
negative wave
poured down
from Okita onto
Ryoma.

entries.jp:
龍馬は全力を振り絞って
立ち上がり
沖田が放った負の波動を
我が身に受け止めた
entries.en:
Ryoma summoned
all his strength,
stood up, and
took the negative
wave Okita
unleashed full on.

entries.jp: ぐあああっ\nなんなんじゃあっ！
entries.en: Gwaaah! What IS\nthis!?

entries.jp: 目を……覚ませ\nソウちん……
entries.en: Wake... up...\nSo-chin...

entries.jp: トサカくん\n頑張りすぎると死ぬよ
entries.en: Tosaka-kun, if\nyou try too hard,\nyou'll die.

entries.jp: あ……違うね……\n頑張らなくても\n死んじゃうんだよね
entries.en:
Ah... no, that's
wrong... You'll die
even if you don't
try, won't you?

entries.jp: なんじゃ？\n負の波動がわしの片魂を\n黒くしていく……
entries.en:
What the? The
negative wave's
turnin' my Piece
Soul black...

entries.jp: なんじゃろう？\n怒りや憎しみじゃない
entries.en: What is this? It\nain't anger or\nhatred...

entries.jp: 切ない負の力を\n感じる……
entries.en:
I'm feelin' a
heartbreakin' kind
of negative
power...

entries.jp: おい　龍馬！\nしっかりしろ　てめぇが\n呑み込まれてどうする！
entries.en:
Hey, Ryoma! Get a
grip! What good
are you if YOU
get swallowed
up!?

entries.jp: 気をしっかり持って\n龍馬くんっ！
entries.en: Stay strong,\nRyoma-kun!

entries.jp:
龍馬は強く目を瞑り
歯を噛み締め
血が滲むほど
握り拳を固め　強い力を
はね除けようとする
entries.en:
Eyes squeezed
shut, teeth
gritted, fists
clenched until
they bled, Ryoma
tried to throw off
the mighty force.

entries.jp:
しかし
その抵抗も虚しく
沖田の黒い力に
呑み込まれ龍馬は
意識を失っていった
entries.en:
But his resistance
was in vain.
Swallowed by
Okita's black
power, Ryoma
lost
consciousness.

entries.jp:
意識を失った
龍馬の脳裏に
不思議な光景が
浮かんだのは
次の瞬間だった
entries.en:
It was in the very
next instant that
a strange scene
rose up in the
mind of the
unconscious
Ryoma.

entries.jp: なんじゃ……\nちっちゃい子供が\n火の中で泣いちょる……
entries.en:
What's this... A
tiny kid's cryin' in
the middle of a
fire...

entries.jp: ……なにか見えるの？
entries.en: ...You can see\nsomething?

entries.jp: ああ……\n盗人が……\n子供を手下にしちょる
entries.en: Ah... A thief... He's\nusin' a kid as his\nlackey.

entries.jp: ああっ\n盗みに入った家に\n火を放ちよった！
entries.en: Ah! He set fire to\nthe house he just\nrobbed!

entries.jp: くそぅ\nなんちゅうことを！
entries.en: Damn it! What a\nthing to do!

entries.jp: 火事の中へ子供を放って\n逃げだしたっ！
entries.en: He left the kid in\nthe fire and ran\noff!

entries.jp: なんて酷いことをする！\n許せん！
entries.en: What a cruel\nthing to do! I can't\nforgive that!

entries.jp: なぜ……\nどうして見えるの？
entries.en: Why... How can\nyou see that?

entries.jp: わしにはわからんが\n勝手に見えてくるんじゃ
entries.en: Beats me. It just\ncomes to me on\nits own.

entries.jp: 見えるはずが\nない……
entries.en: There's no way...\nyou could see it...

entries.jp: あれは……\nソウちん……？
entries.en: That kid... is\nthat... So-chin...?

entries.jp: 僕は歌う……\n歌う　歌う
entries.en: I'll sing... sing...\nsing...

entries.jp: ソウちん！\nやめるんじゃ！
entries.en: So-chin! Stop it!

entries.jp: 意識を取り戻した龍馬は\n黒い気を押して立ち上がる
entries.en:
Coming back to
his senses, Ryoma
pushed against
the black energy
and rose to his
feet.

entries.jp: 見るなよ……\n僕の歌に呑み込まれて\nしまえよっ！
entries.en:
Don't look... Just
get swallowed up
by my song
already!

entries.jp:
叫ぶように言った
沖田から
一際黒い気が
放たれた！
entries.en:
Okita all but
screamed the
words, and an
even blacker
energy burst
from him!

entries.jp:
漆黒の気は
龍馬を包み込み
その姿が
隠れてしまうほどだ
entries.en:
The jet-black
energy engulfed
Ryoma until he
was hidden from
sight.

entries.jp: 晋作っ！\n龍馬くんがっ！
entries.en: Shinsaku!\nRyoma-kun is...!

entries.jp: くそっ！\n体が言うことをきかねえ
entries.en: Dammit! My body\nwon't listen!

entries.jp: ぐうっ……私もだ……\nこれは想定出来なかったよ
entries.en: Ngh... Same here...\nI never saw this\ncoming.

entries.jp: 這うようにして龍馬の元へ\n向かう高杉と桂だったが\n漆黒の気が二人を襲った！
entries.en:
Takasugi and
Katsura crawled
toward Ryoma,
but the jet-black
energy struck
them both!

entries.jp: ぐわあっ！
entries.en: Gwaah!

entries.jp: ぐうっ！
entries.en: Ngh!

entries.jp: 二人とも\n邪魔しないでよ
entries.en: Don't get in my\nway, you two.

entries.jp: さっきのがソウちんの\n過去の記憶なら……
entries.en: If that was\nSo-chin's memory\nof his past...

entries.jp: 激しい怒りや憎しみで\n満たされているはず……
entries.en: ...it oughta be full\nof fierce anger\nand hatred...

entries.jp: なのにどうしてこんなに\n切ない気持ちになる？
entries.en: So why does it\nmake me feel so\nheartbroken?

entries.jp: 胸が締め付けられて\n苦しい
entries.en: My chest is all\ntight. It hurts.

entries.jp: 泣き叫びたくなるほど\n悲しい……
entries.en: It's so sad I\nwanna cry out\nloud...

entries.jp: 歌えば\n二度と起こらない\nあんなこと
entries.en: If I sing... that\nwill never happen\nagain.

entries.jp: 僕は歌う！\n歌う！　歌う！\nだから　歌うんだっ！
entries.en: I'll sing! Sing!\nSing! That's why I\nsing!

entries.jp: その負の気は\n過去の記憶から……\n過去の悲しみから……
entries.en:
That negative
energy comes
from your
memories... from
the sadness of
your past...

entries.jp: その悲しみの心を\n井伊に\n利用されとるんじゃ！
entries.en: And Ii's usin' that\nsad heart of\nyours!

entries.jp: 悲しみの心……
entries.en: My sad heart...

entries.jp: なあソウちん\n人間ちゅうのは弱い\n生き物じゃと思う
entries.en: Y'know, So-chin, I\nreckon people are\nweak creatures.

entries.jp: 悪は許されん事じゃ\nじゃけど悪人にも悪事を\n働く事情があると思う
entries.en:
Evil can't be
forgiven. But I
figure even bad
folks have their
reasons for doin'
wrong.

entries.jp: ……悪者の\n味方をするの？
entries.en: ...So you're taking\nthe villains' side?

entries.jp: そうじゃない\n違うんじゃ　ソウちん
entries.en: That ain't it. You\ngot it wrong,\nSo-chin.

entries.jp: 悪人の哀しみも\n善人の苦しみも\n受け入れにゃならん
entries.en:
We gotta accept
the sorrow of the
wicked and the
pain of the good
alike.

entries.jp: 悪も……受け入れる？\nはは　キレイゴトを\n言ってくれるね
entries.en: Accept evil too?\nHa... Such pretty\nwords.

entries.jp: わしの言うことが\nソウちんには\nきれい事に聞こえるか？
entries.en:
Does what I'm
sayin' sound like
pretty words to
you, So-chin?

entries.jp: 泰平を乱す歌を歌う\nトサカくんは悪だよね
entries.en:
You sing songs
that disturb the
peace,
Tosaka-kun. That
makes you evil,
right?

entries.jp: 天歌がまことの正義なら\nわしのロックは悪かも\nしれん
entries.en:
If Heaven's Song
is true justice,
then maybe my
rock is evil.

entries.jp: じゃけど　天歌は本当に\n正義か？
entries.en: But is Heaven's\nSong really\njustice?

entries.jp: 正義だと……\n思うよ
entries.en: I think... it is.

entries.jp: ソウちん　思い出せ\nまことの歌は人を縛る\nものじゃないはずじゃ
entries.en:
Remember,
So-chin. A true
song ain't
supposed to bind
people.

entries.jp: トサカくんの\n思い違いじゃ\nないのかな
entries.en:
Aren't you the
one who's
mistaken,
Tosaka-kun?

entries.jp: まことの歌は人の心を\n豊かにするものじゃ\n違うか　ソウちん
entries.en:
A true song
makes people's
hearts richer.
Ain't that right,
So-chin?

entries.jp: 人の心を……\n豊かにするもの……
entries.en: Makes people's\nhearts... richer...

entries.jp: わしはロックを歌うて\nすっかりお尋ね者じゃ\nでも　それでええ
entries.en:
I sang rock and
became a wanted
man for it. But
that's just fine.

entries.jp: 人々にまことの歌を\n聴いてもらいたい\n目を覚ましてもらいたい
entries.en:
I want folks to
hear a true song.
I want 'em to
wake up.

entries.jp: その気持ちがわしの\n魂を揺さぶったんじゃ
entries.en: That feelin' is\nwhat shook my\nsoul!

entries.jp: でもさ　トサカくん\n僕の歌でみんなは\n熱狂してるよ？
entries.en:
But hey,
Tosaka-kun,
everyone's going
wild over my
song, you know?

entries.jp: 楽しくなったじゃない\n倒れるほどにさ
entries.en:
They're having
fun, aren't they?
So much fun
they're falling
over.

entries.jp: それはまやかしじゃ\nまやかしの喜びぜよ
entries.en: That's a sham. A\nsham of joy!

entries.jp: まやかし？\n僕の歌がまやかしだって\nひどいこと言うね
entries.en:
A sham? You're
calling my song a
sham? That's a
cruel thing to say.

entries.jp: なぁ\n彦根で見た人たちは\n確かに笑顔じゃった
entries.en:
Listen. The
people we saw in
Hikone were
smilin', sure
enough.

entries.jp: けど　わしには\n死人みたいに見えた
entries.en: But to me, they\nlooked like dead\nmen.

entries.jp: あれは本当の喜びか？\n楽しいっていうのは\n操られるのとは違うぜよ
entries.en:
Is that real joy?
Havin' fun ain't
the same as bein'
controlled!

entries.jp: ソウちんも\nわかっている\nはずじゃ
entries.en: You oughta know\nthat too, So-chin.

entries.jp: ……それでも　いい\n天歌を聴いていれば\n争いはないんだ
entries.en:
...Even so, that's
fine. As long as
people listen to
Heaven's Song,
there's no
fighting.

entries.jp: 殺される子供もいないんだ\nそうだろ　トサカくん？
entries.en:
No children
getting killed,
either. Right,
Tosaka-kun?

entries.jp: 可哀相になぁ……\nソウちん
entries.en: Ah, poor So-chin...

entries.jp: 僕を哀れむなっ！
entries.en: Don't you pity me!

entries.jp: わしは　幼いお前に\n歌ってやりたいぜよ
entries.en:
I wish I could
sing for you back
when you were
little.

entries.jp: 楽しくて　元気が出て\n笑顔になる　歌……\n心が自由になる歌を
entries.en:
A song that's fun,
that lifts you up
and makes you
smile... A song
that sets your
heart free.

entries.jp: 心が自由になる……歌
entries.en: A song that sets\nyour heart free...

entries.jp: それがロックの魂\nなんじゃ！
entries.en: That's the soul of\nrock!

entries.jp: ロックの魂……
entries.en: The soul of rock...

entries.jp: わしゃあ\nソウちんの悲しみが\n切ないぜよ
entries.en: Your sadness\nbreaks my heart,\nSo-chin, I tell ya.

entries.jp: ソウちんは\n争いを無くしたかった\nだから天歌を歌った……
entries.en:
So-chin, you
wanted to put an
end to fighting.
That's why you
sang Heaven's
Song...

entries.jp: その気持ちはようわかる\nただ天歌は――\n人を幸福にはしないぜよ
entries.en:
I get that feelin',
I really do. But
Heaven's Song-- it
don't make people
happy!

entries.jp: あれは自由な心を\n抑え込む歌じゃ！
entries.en: It's a song that\nholds down free\nhearts!

entries.jp: 争いが無くなることもない\n知っているか　ソウちん
entries.en:
And it won't end
the fighting,
either. Did you
know, So-chin?

entries.jp: 天歌に洗脳された人々が\nまた天歌を聴くために\n争っているのを
entries.en:
Folks
brainwashed by
Heaven's Song are
fightin' each
other just to hear
it again.

entries.jp: ……あはは　やっぱり\nトサカくんはすごいや
entries.en:
...Ahaha. You
really are
amazing,
Tosaka-kun.

entries.jp: ただのバカじゃ\nなかったんだね
entries.en: You weren't just\nan idiot after all.

entries.jp: もっと――\nもっと早く気付いていれば\nもっと早く出会っていれば
entries.en:
If only... if only
I'd realized
sooner... if only
we'd met sooner...

entries.jp: トサカくんを死なせずに\n済んだかもしれなかった
entries.en:
...maybe I
wouldn't have had
to let you die,
Tosaka-kun.

entries.jp: まだ遅くない\nわしらはわかりあえる\nんじゃ！
entries.en:
It ain't too late!
We can
understand each
other!

entries.jp: ……遅いよ
entries.en: ...It's too late.

entries.jp: ただやり方が\n違っただけじゃ！
entries.en: We just went\nabout it different\nways, that's all!

entries.jp: もう遅いんだよ\n全て　手遅れなんだ\nトサカくん
entries.en: It's already too\nlate. It's all too\nlate, Tosaka-kun.

entries.jp: もう僕には……\n止められない
entries.en: I can't... stop it\nanymore.

entries.jp: いかん！\n天歌はやめろ！\nソウちんの身が持たない！
entries.en:
No good! Stop
Heaven's Song!
Your body can't
take it, So-chin!

entries.jp: どう……したら\n止まるか……\nもう……わから……
entries.en: How... do I... make\nit stop... I don't...\nknow any...

entries.jp: わしが救ってみせるっ\nソウちん
entries.en: I'll save you,\nSo-chin, just you\nwatch!

entries.jp: うおおおおおおおおおお！
entries.en: Uwoooooooooooh!

entries.jp: トサカ……くん？
entries.en: Tosaka... kun?

entries.jp: 天歌が止まった！
entries.en: Heaven's Song\nstopped!

entries.jp: よし　今だっ！
entries.en: All right, now's\nour chance!

entries.jp: ソウちんを\n悲しみから救うぜよ！
entries.en: I'm gonna save\nSo-chin from his\nsadness!

entries.jp: わしのロックを聴いて\n自由を取り戻すんじゃ\nソウちん！
entries.en:
Listen to my rock
and take back
your freedom,
So-chin!

entries.jp: わしのロックで\n自由になれ！\n笑顔になってくれ
entries.en: Get free with my\nrock! Smile for\nme!

entries.jp: 本当のソウちんの歌を\n歌えるように
entries.en:
So you can sing
the songs that are
truly yours,
So-chin!

entries.jp: トサカくん……
entries.en: Tosaka-kun...

entries.jp: 聴け！　ソウちん\nわしの歌で魂を震わせろ！
entries.en:
Listen up,
So-chin! Let my
song make your
soul tremble!

entries.jp: 心の底から痺れて\n熱く！　熱く！\n熱く！　魂を燃やせ
entries.en:
Feel it tinglin'
from the bottom
of your heart,
and burn your
soul hot! Hot!
HOT!

entries.jp: 悲しみの氷を\n溶かすんじゃああああ
entries.en: Melt that ice of\nsadness\nawaaaaay!
